notes: No genuine Bestsellers/Mas Vendidos/Populares merchandising PLP found on sklum.com/es. Checked: (1) full homepage HTML (header/mega-menu, all nav links, footer, promo banners) for 'vendid', 'popular', 'best-sell', 'top vent', 'favorit', 'preferid' -- zero matches; (2) footer 'Busquedas Interesantes' (Interesting Searches) content page -- no bestseller-type links; (3) the site's full general product+category sitemap (https://www.sklum.com/es/img/core/skl/feed/sitemaps/general_sitemap_skl_es.xml, 2.65MB) case-insensitive regex-scanned for 'vendid'/'popular' -- zero matches; (4) direct URL probes for /es/mas-vendidos, /es/best-sellers, /es/bestsellers, /es/populares, /es/mejores-ventas, /es/lo-mas-vendido, /es/top-ventas, /es/best-sales, /es/module/bestsellers/bestsellers -- all returned 404; (5) PrestaShop's native best-sellers controller (index.php?controller=best-sales) returned HTTP 500 (module not installed/active on this store). Sklum is confirmed PrestaShop-based (per prior access-notes pass) and PrestaShop ships an optional 'blockbestsellers' module, but this store does not have it enabled and exposes no equivalent custom listing. Access: direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome124 impersonation) worked throughout, no WAF/block encountered. Conclusion: genuine absence, not a search-blind-spot -- the site has a rich, working 'Special Price'/Outlet and 'Novedades'/New-Arrivals taxonomy (see cl119.json/na119.json), so the taxonomy-discovery method is proven to surface real merchandising sections on this store, and it surfaced nothing for Bestsellers.
